_comment: Golden table for the ONE tag-slug derivation.
Both suites go red if either implementation moves. That is the point.

cases.name: Dahab
cases.why: case is folded -- the live GSC URL /search?tag=Dahab

cases.name: AlexeiNavalny
cases.why: camel case collapses to one token

cases.name: t shirts
cases.why: a space becomes the same separator -- COLLIDES with t-shirts

cases.name: T/Shirts
cases.why: a slash becomes the same separator -- COLLIDES with t-shirts
path traversal has no slug at all
emoji only -- no hub, falls back to /search?tag=

cases.name: café
cases.why: decomposed e-acute -- NFC makes it the same slug

cases.name: straße
cases.why: sharp s is a lowercase letter and survives

cases.name: STRASSE
cases.why: and does NOT collide with it -- lower(), not casefold()

cases.name: İstanbul
cases.why: dotted capital I lowercases to i + U+0307 in BOTH runtimes

cases.name: N°1
cases.why: degree sign is a symbol, not a number
a dot inside a number is still a separator
astral mathematical digits are Nd and survive

cases.name: zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
cases.why: the longest name taggit can store still round-trips whole

cases.name: the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog the quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog and keeps running far past two hundred code points in total
cases.why: past the bound: truncated at a word boundary (unreachable for a storable tag, since Tag.name is 100)
